description: Zero-shot statistical induction rules for unseen domains, fallback universal metric generators, and automatic column semantic classification.

universal_kpi_templates.name: Total Record Volume
universal_kpi_templates.description: Total count of records or events captured in the dataset.
universal_kpi_templates.sql_template: SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS BIGINT) AS metric_value FROM df

universal_kpi_templates.name: Aggregate Primary Measure
universal_kpi_templates.description: Total sum of the inferred primary quantitative measure.
universal_kpi_templates.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM({primary_measure}) AS DOUBLE), 2) AS metric_value FROM df WHERE {primary_measure} IS NOT NULL

universal_kpi_templates.name: Average Primary Measure
universal_kpi_templates.description: Mean value of the primary quantitative measure per record.
universal_kpi_templates.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG({primary_measure}) AS DOUBLE), 2) AS metric_value FROM df WHERE {primary_measure} IS NOT NULL

universal_kpi_templates.name: Unique Entity Cardinality
universal_kpi_templates.description: Total number of unique entities or subjects observed.
universal_kpi_templates.sql_template: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT {entity_id}) AS BIGINT) AS metric_value FROM df WHERE {entity_id} IS NOT NULL

universal_kpi_templates.name: Measure per Entity Ratio
universal_kpi_templates.description: Aggregate primary measure normalized by unique entity count.
universal_kpi_templates.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM({primary_measure}) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT {entity_id}), 0) AS DOUBLE), 2) AS metric_value FROM df WHERE {primary_measure} IS NOT NULL

universal_dimensional_templates.description: Universal distribution and volume breakdown across primary categorical dimension.
universal_dimensional_templates.sql_template: SELECT CAST({primary_dimension} AS VARCHAR) AS entity, ROUND(CAST(SUM({primary_measure}) AS DOUBLE), 2) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM df WHERE {primary_dimension} IS NOT NULL GROUP BY {primary_dimension} ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 15

universal_dimensional_templates.description: Temporal chronological trajectory of primary quantitative measure.
universal_dimensional_templates.sql_template: SELECT strftime(TRY_CAST({temporal_dimension} AS TIMESTAMP), '%Y-%m') AS entity, ROUND(CAST(SUM({primary_measure}) AS DOUBLE), 2) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM df WHERE {temporal_dimension} IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CAST({temporal_dimension} AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY entity ORDER BY entity ASC
